name: list comprehension filters and projects
query: RETURN [x IN range(1, 5) WHERE x % 2 = 1 | x * x] AS values

name: conditional aggregation reads node properties
query: MATCH (f:File) RETURN count(f) AS files, sum(CASE WHEN f.embedded = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS embedded

name: comma separated create patterns share scope
merge property after set with uses bound node value
query: MERGE (a:T {id: 1}) SET a.q = 1 WITH a MERGE (b:X {k: a.id}) RETURN b.k AS k

name: create merge set keeps merged variable
query: CREATE (a:T {id: 1}) MERGE (n:X {k: a.id}) SET n.extra = 2 RETURN n.k AS k, n.extra AS extra

name: correlated call with projected where filters rows
query: UNWIND [1, 2, 3] AS i CALL (i) { WITH i AS j WHERE j > 1 RETURN j AS value } RETURN value ORDER BY value

name: unit write subquery executes once per outer row
query: UNWIND [1, 2] AS i CALL () { CREATE (:X) } RETURN count(*) AS count

name: foreach merge retains outer row
query: MATCH (a:T) FOREACH (v IN [1, 2] | MERGE (:X {k: v})) RETURN a.id AS id
